errors.text: The predicted shape evolution is reversed: the target reports an elliptical-to-spherical transition, whereas the hypothesis predicts spherical-to-faceted or irregular particles and fragmentation.
The mechanism omits Cu as a major low-surface-energy segregating and evaporating component and instead attributes loss primarily to Au volatility.
The cited evidence concerns chemically and physically different bulk HEA systems and does not substantiate diffusion, segregation, or evaporation in AuCoCuNiPt nanoparticles.
